lines.text: How much more rope? Round the whole Earth, lifted one meter off the ground.
lines.phonemes: hˌaʊ mˈʌtʃ mˈɔːɹ ɹˈoʊp? ɹˈaʊnd ðə hˈoʊl ˈɜːθ, lˈɪftᵻd wˈʌn mˈiːɾɚɹ ˈɔf ðə ɡɹˈaʊnd.

lines.text: Start with a rope that hugs the planet, about forty thousand kilometers long. Now lift it one meter above the ground, everywhere.
lines.phonemes: stˈɑːɹt wɪð ɐ ɹˈoʊp ðæt hˈʌɡz ðə plˈænɪt, ɐbˌaʊt fˈɔːɹɾi θˈaʊzənd kɪlˈɑːmɪɾɚz lˈɔŋ. nˈaʊ lˈɪft ɪt wˈʌn mˈiːɾɚɹ əbˌʌv ðə ɡɹˈaʊnd, ˈɛvɹɪwˌɛɹ.

lines.text: A whole planet of rope, lifted all at once. You might guess it needs thousands of kilometers more.
lines.phonemes: ɐ hˈoʊl plˈænɪt ʌv ɹˈoʊp, lˈɪftᵻd ˈɔːl ɐtwˈʌns. juː mˌaɪt ɡˈɛs ɪt nˈiːdz θˈaʊzəndz ʌv kɪlˈɑːmɪɾɚz mˈɔːɹ.

lines.text: But a circle's length is two times pi times its radius, the distance to its center. Lift the rope a meter, and the radius grows a meter.
lines.phonemes: bˌʌt ɐ sˈɜːkəlz lˈɛŋθ ɪz tˈuː tˈaɪmz pˈaɪ tˈaɪmz ɪts ɹˈeɪdɪəs, ðə dˈɪstəns tʊ ɪts sˈɛntɚ. lˈɪft ðə ɹˈoʊp ɐ mˈiːɾɚ, ænd ðə ɹˈeɪdɪəs ɡɹˈoʊz ɐ mˈiːɾɚ.

lines.text: So the rope grows by two times pi times one meter, a bit over six meters. That is about four of you, lying head to toe.
lines.phonemes: sˌoʊ ðə ɹˈoʊp ɡɹˈoʊz baɪ tˈuː tˈaɪmz pˈaɪ tˈaɪmz wˈʌn mˈiːɾɚ, ɐ bˈɪt ˌoʊvɚ sˈɪks mˈiːɾɚz. ðæt ɪz ɐbˌaʊt fˈɔːɹ ʌv juː, lˈaɪɪŋ hˈɛd tə tˈoʊ.

lines.text: Try a basketball or the Sun: lift the rope one meter, and the extra rope is the same.
lines.phonemes: tɹˈaɪ ɐ bˈæskɪtbˌɔːl ɔːɹ ðə sˈʌn: lˈɪft ðə ɹˈoʊp wˈʌn mˈiːɾɚ, ænd ðɪ ˈɛkstɹɚ ɹˈoʊp ɪz ðə sˈeɪm.

lines.text: The planet's size cancels out: only the lift matters. Ten times higher needs ten times more rope.
lines.phonemes: ðə plˈænɪts sˈaɪz kˈænsəlz ˈaʊt: ˈoʊnli ðə lˈɪft mˈæɾɚz. tˈɛn tˈaɪmz hˈaɪɚ nˈiːdz tˈɛn tˈaɪmz mˈɔːɹ ɹˈoʊp.

lines.text: Next envelope: a shuffled deck, and a very rare order.
lines.phonemes: nˈɛkst ˈɑːnvəlˌoʊp: ɐ ʃˈʌfəld dˈɛk, ænd ɐ vˈɛɹi ɹˈɛɹ ˈɔːɹdɚ.
